include(FetchContent)
include(GNUInstallDirs)

if (CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS "3.24")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Vendored FAISS requires CMake 3.24 or newer")
endif()

set(FAISS_ENABLE_GPU    OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_ROCM   OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_CUVS   OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_METAL  OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_PYTHON OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_C_API  OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_EXTRAS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_SVS    OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_ENABLE_MKL    OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_USE_LTO       OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FAISS_OPT_LEVEL "generic" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

set(_llama_faiss_module_path "${CMAKE_MODULE_PATH}")
if (NOT GGML_OPENMP_ENABLED)
    list(PREPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
    message(STATUS "premise-server: building FAISS without OpenMP")
endif()

add_library(llama-faiss-blas STATIC blas-shim.cpp)
target_compile_features(llama-faiss-blas PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
install(TARGETS llama-faiss-blas EXPORT faiss-targets ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})

set(_llama_faiss_restore_blas OFF)
if (DEFINED BLAS_LIBRARIES)
    set(_llama_faiss_restore_blas ON)
    set(_llama_faiss_blas_libraries "${BLAS_LIBRARIES}")
endif()
set(_llama_faiss_restore_lapack OFF)
if (DEFINED LAPACK_LIBRARIES)
    set(_llama_faiss_restore_lapack ON)
    set(_llama_faiss_lapack_libraries "${LAPACK_LIBRARIES}")
endif()
set(BLAS_LIBRARIES   llama-faiss-blas CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(LAPACK_LIBRARIES llama-faiss-blas CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

set(_llama_faiss_restore_build_testing OFF)
if (DEFINED BUILD_TESTING)
    set(_llama_faiss_restore_build_testing ON)
    set(_llama_faiss_build_testing "${BUILD_TESTING}")
endif()
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(_llama_faiss_restore_shared_libs OFF)
if (DEFINED BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    set(_llama_faiss_restore_shared_libs ON)
    set(_llama_faiss_shared_libs "${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}")
endif()
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

message(STATUS "premise-server: FAISS package not found, fetching FAISS v1.14.3")
FetchContent_Declare(faiss
    URL https://github.com/facebookresearch/faiss/archive/refs/tags/v1.14.3.tar.gz
    URL_HASH SHA256=7f3c4ed9aec3bd7524382862f5fcbd4d8984e2a8979ff3bdb2c0bcea5144149e
    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP NEW
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(faiss)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${_llama_faiss_module_path}")

if (WIN32 AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "(aarch64|arm64|ARM64)" AND CMAKE_CXX_SIMULATE_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    get_target_property(_llama_faiss_compile_definitions faiss COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
    list(REMOVE_ITEM _llama_faiss_compile_definitions COMPILE_SIMD_ARM_NEON)
    set_property(TARGET faiss PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${_llama_faiss_compile_definitions}")

    get_target_property(_llama_faiss_sources faiss SOURCES)
    list(FILTER _llama_faiss_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "(neon|aarch64)\\.cpp$")
    set_property(TARGET faiss PROPERTY SOURCES "${_llama_faiss_sources}")
endif()

if (_llama_faiss_restore_blas)
    set(BLAS_LIBRARIES "${_llama_faiss_blas_libraries}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
else()
    unset(BLAS_LIBRARIES CACHE)
endif()
if (_llama_faiss_restore_lapack)
    set(LAPACK_LIBRARIES "${_llama_faiss_lapack_libraries}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
else()
    unset(LAPACK_LIBRARIES CACHE)
endif()

if (_llama_faiss_restore_build_testing)
    set(BUILD_TESTING "${_llama_faiss_build_testing}" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
else()
    unset(BUILD_TESTING CACHE)
endif()
if (_llama_faiss_restore_shared_libs)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "${_llama_faiss_shared_libs}" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
else()
    unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS CACHE)
endif()
